The watchman's shack's lamp reserve, wall calendar and stool by the window. Errata 184 looked at the shipped plate (art/backgrounds/room-21-watchmans-shack.png): there is a table with two chairs, a stove, a coat, a cot and the tally marks, and none of these three.
